policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: Paraguay visa-free visitor entry
policies.summary: Current DFAT guidance says regular Australian passport holders need no Paraguayan visitor visa for stays up to 90 days.
conditions: The exemption is for a regular Australian passport and a stay up to 90 days.
This excludes other passport types, work, residence, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: Australian ordinary-passport tourists can obtain Jordan's single-entry 90-day visa on arrival at the named airport or border crossings.
conditions: The stated entry visa is single-entry and valid for 90 days; land-crossing fees must be paid in cash.
Visits over 90 days and non-tourist purposes require advance arrangements; work, study, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: North Macedonia visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Australian ordinary-passport visitors can enter North Macedonia visa-free for up to 90 days in a six-month period.
conditions: The stated maximum stay is 90 days in a six-month period.
This excludes residence, work, special documents and final admission.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: Iran advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Australians must obtain Iran's visa through the Iranian Embassy in Australia before travel.
conditions: DFAT directs Australians to apply before travel through the Iranian Embassy in Australia; this is not an arrival-issued route.
Australian-Iranian dual nationals, exit visas, work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Australian ordinary-passport visitors need Trinidad and Tobago's electronically issued visa before travel.
conditions: Apply through the official e-Visa Online Portal at least 14 business days before travel; the stated product is a multiple-entry eVisa.
A discretionary airport visa waiver for travellers who arrive without a visa is not the ordinary planned-visitor baseline.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: Syria electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: An Australian ordinary-passport traveller without Syrian identity documents needs a Syrian visa and may apply for it electronically.
conditions: This applies only where the traveller does not hold Syrian identity documents; Australian-Syrian dual nationals are treated as Syrian by Syrian authorities.
Work, residence, local permits, operational travel restrictions and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Syria electronic visa service
steps: Apply for the Syrian eVisa online before travel using the ordinary Australian passport to be used for entry.
